source_dataset: PhysioNet/Computing in Cardiology Challenge 2019 raw training PSV files
target_definition: 1 if inferred annotated sepsis onset occurs in the next 1..6 hourly rows; otherwise 0. For sepsis patients, onset position is inferred as the first source SepsisLabel=1 row plus the documented 6-hour source-label shift. Rows at/after inferred onset are excluded. For non-sepsis patients, the final horizon rows are dropped because the future observation window is incomplete.
split_method: stratified patient-level 70/15/15 split; a patient appears in only one split
important_label_note: The previous project target (any positive source SepsisLabel in the next six rows) was not appropriate for early-onset prediction because the source label remains positive after the annotated onset-minus-six-hour point. This corrected target infers the onset position from the first source-positive row plus six hours, labels only rows where onset is in the next horizon, and excludes post-onset rows. This remains a retrospective research target derived from a shifted label, not an ICU-admission model or clinically validated tool.
